# apple_nomination (Resource)

Nominates apps for featuring on the App Store: a launch, an update or new content. A nomination is a draft until `submitted` is `true`. A submitted nomination can't return to draft, so setting `submitted = false` then replaces it with a new draft. Destroying the resource deletes the nomination. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_nomination" "launch" {
  name               = "Example 2.0"
  type               = "APP_ENHANCEMENTS"
  description        = "A redesigned editor with real-time collaboration."
  app_ids            = [data.apple_app.example.id]
  publish_start_date = "2026-12-01T16:00:00Z"
  device_families    = ["IPHONE", "IPAD"]
  locales            = ["en-US"]
  submitted          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the apps nominated.
- `description` (String) What makes the launch, update or content notable.
- `name` (String) Name of the nomination.
- `publish_start_date` (String) When the launch, update or content becomes available, in UTC, e.g. `2026-12-01T16:00:00Z`.
- `type` (String) What is nominated: `APP_LAUNCH`, `APP_ENHANCEMENTS`, `NEW_CONTENT`.

### Optional

- `device_families` (Set of String) Device families: `APPLE_TV`, `APPLE_WATCH`, `IPAD`, `IPHONE`, `MAC`, `VISION`.
- `launch_in_select_markets_first` (Boolean) Whether the app launches in some markets before the others.
- `locales` (Set of String) Locales of the launch, e.g. `en-US`.
- `notes` (String) Other information for the editorial team.
- `pre_order_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app is available for pre-order.
- `publish_end_date` (String) When it stops being available, for time-limited content, in UTC.
- `submitted` (Boolean) Whether the nomination is submitted to Apple. Defaults to `false`, a draft.
- `supplemental_materials_uris` (List of String) Links to supporting material, such as press kits or videos.
- `territory_ids` (Set of String) Territories of the launch, e.g. `USA`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the nomination.
- `state` (String) State of the nomination: `DRAFT`, `SUBMITTED`, `ARCHIVED`.
- `submitted_date` (String) When the nomination was submitted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_nomination.launch
  identity = {
    id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the nomination.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_nomination.launch 1234567890
```
